Long-term contracting relevant to the group is (a) gas ship-or-pay/firm-transport capacity contracts at TGI/Cálidda/Contugas and (b) energy sales via regulated auctions (ACR) and free-market (ACL) contracts at the Enel Colombia associate — both sit below/outside GEB's own P&L as an operator and are not disclosed by GEB as its PPAs, hence the empty PPAs array.
